text:
ajay: Quick idea — proposal for a symmetric percent-ramp canary rollout for model swaps. Want feedback before I make a PR.

devon: What do you mean by symmetric?

ajay: Start at 0, step up to peak, then mirror down to 0. The idea is to exercise both increase and decrease paths automatically and limit long tail exposure. Example steps I sketched: 0 → 2 → 8 → 20 → 50 → 20 → 8 → 2 → 0.

sophie: Mirror ramp could double the total exposure time at intermediate percents. Why not have a short plateau at peak instead of a full mirror?

ajay: Plateau at peak is part of it — think of it as up, plateau, then symmetric down. Plateau default 5m. Abort/hold if health signals degrade.

ben: We also need per-route quotas and sticky hashing considerations. If a single customer dominates a route, a 50% peak could still blow their SLA.

maria: Proposed config snippet (YAML):
```yaml
canary:
  strategy: symmetric-ramp
  steps:
    - percent: 2
      duration: 2m
    - percent: 8
      duration: 3m
    - percent: 20
      duration: 5m
    - percent: 50
      duration: 5m
  mirror_down: true
  plateau: 5m
  abort_conditions:
    - metric: error_rate
      window: 3m
      threshold: 0.005
    - metric: p95_latency
      window: 3m
      relative_increase: 0.20
  jitter_seed: route_id
  max_exposure_per_customer: 0.01
```

devon: jitter_seed=route_id will keep users pinned to the same cohort which is good for sessioned apps but could concentrate noise. Might want option to randomize per-request for stateless APIs.

ajay: Agreed — default to sticky for stateful, override for stateless. max_exposure_per_customer should mitigate concentration.

sophie: Telemetry hooks: we should emit a sampled evaluation bundle at every step (small holdout + traffic cohort) and run automated evals against a set of golden prompts. Also emit step_enter/step_exit events with tags: model_version, route, step_percent.

ben: Operator guard: add a global QPS cap so we never exceed capacity if route traffic distribution skews. Also add a hard abort when backend CPU/GPU util > 80% averaged over 1m.

maria: For console UX: users expect a single progress bar and a visual of the mirror-down curve. We should hide mirror complexity behind an "advanced" toggle and surface estimated cumulative exposure and per-customer exposure.

ops-bot: NOTE: current router supports percent splits and sticky-hash. No built-in symmetric mirror semantics — implementing mirror_down will require a router scheduler change and small rollout orchestration logic.

ajay: I'll open a small infra PR: router change + canary controller accepts symmetric=true. Default behavior remains monotonic ramp unless symmetric enabled. Will also add dry-run mode.

sophie: :thumbsup: Dry-run that simulates cohort assignment + emits expected percent/time series would be super helpful for quota planning.

devon: Also add a console toggle to show per-step telemetry panels and wire a dashboard template for the canary policy.

canary-bot: Canary policy created: strategy=symmetric-ramp id=c-20260303-14 by ajay

ajay: Thanks all — I'll post the PR link and a short demo gif once the router change lands.
